description: Reads one entry of RestaurantDoctorAI's library in full (a guide, a blog post, a playbook fix, the targets, a fact or a knowledge entry), by the id restaurantdoctor_search_knowledge gave, with its title, link and source. Use it when a passage isn't enough to answer well. Long entries are cut at 8,000 characters; the link has the rest. The query isn't stored; only an anonymous daily count of searches and reads is kept.

id.description: An entry id from restaurantdoctor_search_knowledge, e.g. 'guide:restaurant-prime-cost' or 'post:restaurant-break-even-point'.

name: restaurantdoctor_read_knowledge

source.description: Who says so, with the date it was checked or updated where there is one.

text.description: The entry's full text, up to 8,000 characters.

truncated.description: The text was longer and was cut; the link has the rest.

url.description: Where a reader can check it: the page on restaurantdoctorai.com, or the fact's own source.

title: Read a library entry
